title: The Lid in the Mud
lines: Ned has a red pot and a tin lid.
A pup got the lid and ran.
Ned ran, but he did not get it.
The lid is in the mud.
Ned sat on a log. He is sad.
The pup digs at the mud. Dig, dig!
Ned digs at it and gets the lid!
"Look!" said Ned. He hugs the pup, and it naps.

questions.ask: Where did the lid end up?
questions.listenFor: In the mud. It is said right in the story. If your child is stuck, point at that line and let them read it again rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Who got the lid back, and how?
questions.listenFor: Ned did, with the pup. The pup digs at the spot, and Ned digs the lid out. Lines six and seven tell it together. If they say the pup did it all, ask who got the lid out of the mud.

questions.ask: How did Ned feel when the lid went in the mud? Find the words that tell you.
questions.listenFor: Sad — line five says he sat on a log and he is sad. Let them find the word sad.
